settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: We dispatch from the workshop in Jakarta Selatan. Delivery time depends on the shipping method and country you choose at checkout, where the estimate is shown before you pay. (Placeholder: edit with your real dispatch times.)

settings.question: Will I pay import duties or taxes?
settings.answer: Duties and import taxes, if any, are paid by the recipient. Rules differ by country, so please check with your local customs office if you are unsure.

settings.question: My tracking has not moved for days.
settings.answer: Parcels can go several days between scans while crossing borders. If nothing moves for 10 working days, message us with your order number and we will open a trace with the carrier.
